Cost of each activation as terms in entity populations: a shape, not a bound.
  N(T)        entities that carry T
  N(*)        all entities, for a rule that requires no trait
  Δ(T)        entities of T whose inputs changed since the rule's last run
  k           matches per row of a join, not measured
  cells(T)    cells of each carrier of T
  live(T: f)  cells of T whose fields f are not at their defaults
  ×N          the passes of a rule with `repeat: N`
A keep rule is skipped when none of its inputs changed.

phase std.core.tick  depth 1
  shapes.Advance/on std.core.tick  N(Runner)·k ×3
  shapes.Snap/on std.core.tick  live(Room: gas)
  shapes.Fill/on std.core.tick  cells(Room)
  shapes.Spread/on std.core.tick  live(Room: gas)·k

event std.core.load  depth 1
  shapes.Start/on std.core.load  per event: 1

event std.core.unload  depth 1
  std.core.SceneCleanup/on std.core.unload  per event: N(*)
